# climatech

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of climatech is to make it easy to access and analyze data from
INTA weather stations, available through the Agricultural Information and
Management System (SIGA). With climatech you can download and read data from
any station using its ID, get a summary table of shelter temperature for one
or more stations, and plot its monthly average. The package also includes
example data so you can explore its functions without downloading anything.It is
a practice package developed as part of a university course and is not intended 
for real-world use.

## Installation

You can install the development version of climatech from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("moravilar/climatech")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(climatech)
## basic example code
```

What is special about using `README.Rmd` instead of just `README.md`? You can include R chunks like so:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

You'll still need to render `README.Rmd` regularly, to keep `README.md` up-to-date. `devtools::build_readme()` is handy for this.

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo = FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

In that case, don't forget to commit and push the resulting figure files, so they display on GitHub and CRAN.
